title: 第一千六百八十六章 被咬掉一片肉第一千六百八十五章 吃龙肉的人
slug: 荒村物语第一千六百九十四章面包
content_zh:
见没人，花伯这便关上了屋门，不打算去察看了，因为明天还得去干活嘛。
脱去了衣服正准备睡去之时，听闻到有人拍打窗户的声音传来，初时还以为只是一些风声呢，倒也并不放在心上，可是不成，这样的声音变得越发地大了。
甚至感觉有一只手从那窗户边伸进来了，而后趁着一片之漆黑，直接就在花伯的头上摸了摸，甚至还抓了一把他的头发。
这使得花伯简直了，直接就咆哮起来了，不知道何人如此大胆，竟然敢于做这样的事情！
可是出了屋门，往外看去之时，除却荒凉的夜色，几乎什么也看不到。
于是只好是怔怔地坐在屋子门前，再也没有任何心情去睡觉了啊。
……
而在这个时候，少年因为与少女发生了争执，这便独自悄悄地离开了，而后回到一个漆黑的屋子里，开始做起了法事。
因为在争吵的过程中，少女提到了少秋嘛。说当初若是选择少秋，想必就不会跟着他风里来雨里去了，而是早早地睡到床上了。
“那少秋有什么好，你这么记挂着他？”少年不服气，如此问道。
“好就是好，没理由。”少女说完这话，直接就收拾起摊边的东西，而后气乎乎地离开了。
“好吧。”少年不作声了。
……
不得气出的他，这个时候，便独自住在一座漆黑的屋子里了，而那样的屋子，想必最偏僻的地方也比它热闹些。
少年住在那屋子里之后，这便寻来了些稻草，而后略微做了个人，模样与少秋差不多。于是趁着这夜色深沉，而后便用自己的法力驱赶着那个稻草人，一步步地往着花伯的屋子门前而来了。
出现在花伯屋子门前的时候，那稻草人便不断地拍打着屋门，甚至还谩骂着，似乎恨透了花伯，成心不让他在这样的夜色中睡觉似的。
吵得花伯直接就从床上爬了起来，而后拉开了屋门，这便在外面走动着，想弄明白到底是什么东西，非要在这漆黑的夜里来无端作弄自己！
站在屋子门前的时候，四处打量了一下，发现这里真的可以说什么也没有，于是准备离开，而后仍旧还是回到自己的屋子里去了。
正这个时候，夜色变得直如白天一样了。
可以清晰地看到远近的情形，本来一片繁华的都市，此时的光景却不怎么样，甚至略微有些荒凉的味道了。不过这样的情形并非不好，使得花伯感觉到非常清静，于是闭上了眼睛，而后准备休息了。

蓦然回首，发现不远处赫然站着一人，浑身之穿着熟悉不过，可不就是少秋吗？
正准备仔细看去之时，发现夜色直接就变得有些昏暗了，几乎看不清任何东西了都，而此前站在不远处的少秋，也消失在苍茫夜色深处，终于是什么也看不到了。
“妈的。”花伯啐了一口口水，而后便准备回到自己的屋子里了。
“妈的。”站在不远处的少秋也学着花伯的样，下死力啐了一口更大的口水。
……
花伯不想与之一般见识，离开了那里，而后沿着荒凉的古道，渐渐走进自己的屋门了。
劳累了一天，在这样的时候，花伯简直都抬不起眼皮了。此时不睡去，或许真的不好，却依然还是无法睡去，似乎真的是碰到了什么不干净的东西，不然的话，为何神情如此清醒，甚至能够清晰地听闻到小河的呢喃呢？
“这恐怕不可能吧？”花伯怔怔地躺在床上，惶恐地念叨着，“与荒村少说也有上千里的路，这时如何能够聆听到那条小河的呓语呢？”
content_en:
Seeing no one there, Uncle Hua closed the door and didn't plan to check, because he had to go to work tomorrow.
When I took off my clothes and was about to go to sleep, I heard the sound of someone tapping on the window. At first I thought it was just the sound of wind, but I didn't take it to heart, but no, the sound became louder and louder.
I even felt a hand reaching in from the window, and then taking advantage of the darkness, I directly touched Uncle Hua's head, and even grabbed a handful of his hair.
This made Uncle Hua so excited that he started roaring. I wonder who could be so bold as to dare to do such a thing!
But when I walked out of the house and looked outside, I could see almost nothing but the desolate night.
So I had no choice but to sit in front of the house in a daze, no longer in the mood to go to sleep.
…
At this time, the boy had a dispute with the girl, so he quietly left alone, then returned to a dark room and began to perform rituals.
Because during the quarrel, the girl mentioned Shaoqiu. He said that if he had chosen Shaoqiu, he would not have followed him through wind and rain, but would have gone to bed early.
"What's so good about Shaoqiu that you care about him so much?" The young man asked unconvinced.
"Good is good, there is no reason." After the girl said this, she immediately packed up the things beside the stall and left angrily.
"Okay." The young man fell silent.
…
He couldn't let go of his anger. At this time, he lived alone in a dark house, and such a house must be more lively than the most remote place.
After the young man lived in that house, he found some straw and then made a little person, which looked similar to Shaoqiu. So taking advantage of the darkness of the night, he used his magic power to drive the scarecrow away, step by step, towards the door of Uncle Hua's house.
When it appeared in front of Uncle Hua's house, the scarecrow kept banging on the door and even cursed, as if it hated Uncle Hua and deliberately prevented him from sleeping in such a dark night.
The noise made Uncle Hua get up from the bed, and then opened the door of the room, and then walked around outside, trying to figure out what it was that had to play tricks on himself for no reason in this dark night!
When I stood in front of the house, I looked around and found that there was really nothing here, so I was ready to leave, and then I went back to my house.
At this time, the night became as bright as day.
You can clearly see the situation far and near. What was originally a bustling city is now not very good, and even looks a little desolate. However, this situation was not bad, and Hua Bo felt very peaceful, so he closed his eyes and prepared to rest.
Suddenly looking back, I found a person standing not far away. He was dressed in familiar clothes. Isn't it Shaoqiu?
When he was about to take a closer look, he found that the night had become a little dark, and he could hardly see anything clearly. Shaoqiu, who had been standing not far away, also disappeared into the depths of the vast night, and finally nothing could be seen.
"Damn it." Uncle Hua spat, and then prepared to return to his room.
"Damn it." Shaoqiu, who was standing not far away, also followed Hua Bo's example and spat even louder with all his strength.
…
Uncle Hua didn't want to be acquainted with him, so he left there, and then walked along the desolate ancient road and gradually walked into the door of his house.
After a tiring day, Uncle Hua could hardly raise his eyes at a time like this. Maybe it's really bad not to fall asleep at this time, but I still can't fall asleep. It seems that I really touched something unclean. Otherwise, why would I be so awake and can even hear the murmur of the river clearly?
"I'm afraid this is impossible.? "Uncle Hua lay on the bed in a daze, muttering in panic, "We are thousands of miles away from the deserted village, so how can we listen to the murmur of the small river at this time? "
